name: Caius Cosades
title: Spymaster of the Blades
description: The Emperor's man in Balmora — a weathered, pipe-smoking spymaster who guides the Nerevarine from the start.
lore: Retired agent of the Blades sent to Morrowind long before the events of 3E 427 to prepare for the Nerevarine's coming.

name: Dagoth Ur
title: The Sharmat, Lord of the Sixth House
description: The fallen lord of the Sixth House, dreaming beneath Red Mountain with the Heart of Lorkhan, spreading corprus and blight across Vvardenfell.
lore: Once a friend of Nerevar and the Tribunal, he was struck down at the Battle of Red Mountain — but refused to die, and now wears the divinity they stole.

name: Vivec
title: God-King of the Tribunal
description: Warrior-poet and living god of the Tribunal, dwelling in his Palace above the holy city that bears his name.
lore: Vivec is both male and female, mortal and divine — a liar, a poet, and the one Tribunal god who still moves in the world.

name: Almalexia
title: Mother Morrowind, the Lady of Mercy
description: The healing goddess of the Tribunal, guarding the city of Mournhold from the machinations of Sotha Sil.
lore: By 3E 427 her divinity is failing, and with it her sanity.

name: Sotha Sil
title: The Clockwork God
description: The reclusive god of the Tribunal, hidden in his Clockwork City, builder of the Mechanical Heart.
lore: Speaks rarely, sees all; his city is a machine that outlives its maker.

name: Divayth Fyr
title: Master of Tel Fyr
description: One of the greatest wizards of the age, keeper of the Corprusarium and of Yagrum Bagarn.
lore: A reclusive Telvanni master who has cloned his own daughters and holds the key to curing corprus.

name: Fargoth
description: A suspicious wood elf of Seyda Neen who fears the smugglers — and loses things of sentimental value.

name: Tarhiel
title: The Falling Mage
description: An Altmer mage who plummets from the sky near Seyda Neen, clutching a scroll of Icarian Flight.
lore: His scrolls and notes teach the fatal lesson of untested enchantments. 'Icarus! My brother and my doom.'

name: Ajira
description: An ambitious young Khajiit alchemist of the Balmora Mages Guild, eager to rise through the ranks.

name: Yagrum Bagarn
title: The Last Dwarf
description: The last known Dwemer — a dwarven engineer afflicted with corprus, confined to the Corprusarium of Tel Fyr.
lore: His people vanished in 1E 700; his knowledge of the Tools of Kagrenac is without equal.
